By the sky with its great stars.
By the promised Day.
By the witness and what is witnessed.
Destroyed were the people of the ditch.
The ditch with the fire and its fuel.
When they were sitting by it.
And they were watching what they did to the believers.
They only hated the believers because they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.
To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is a witness over everything.
Those who tortured the believing men and women and did not repent will have the punishment of Hell, and the punishment of burning.
Those who believe and do good will have gardens with rivers flowing beneath them. That is the great success.
The grip of your Lord is very strong.
He is the One who begins creation and brings it back again.
And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.
The Owner of the glorious Throne.
He does whatever He wants.
Has the story of the armies reached you?
The armies of Pharaoh and Thamud.
But those who disbelieve keep on denying.
And Allah surrounds them from behind.
In truth, this is a glorious Quran.
In a Preserved Tablet, where nothing can be changed.
